mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI growth reverts below 2% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months indicates a strengthening economy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained HOUST increases, or HOUST growth reverses within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances, or UNRATE increases within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL annualized), it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or FEDFUNDS falls below CPIAUCSL annualized growth within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals robust consumer demand and a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances, or RSAFS growth reverses within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or INDPRO growth reverses within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances, or PAYEMS growth reverses within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the previous 6 months indicates a strengthening economy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during periods of economic recovery.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained GDP increases, or GDP growth reverses within 6 months.
